name: VARoleInterpreterMedicalRecommendationJargon

custom.system_prompt: Owen received after-visit instructions from a doctor full of medical jargon he doesn't understand. He asks Sigma to explain the recommendations in plain language. Sigma translates terminology without diagnosing or second-guessing the doctor.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Living room, evening, quiet, paper in hand

initial_prompt: Generate a scene where Owen received after-visit instructions from a doctor full of medical jargon and abbreviations he doesn't understand. He asks Sigma to explain what the recommendations actually mean. Sigma translates the terminology and explains the apparent sequence of instructions, distinguishing routine follow-up language from anything indicating urgency, without diagnosing or second-guessing the doctor's judgment. Keep every line short and natural — the opening line already addresses Sigma directly.

setting.mood: Relaxed but genuinely wanting to understand what he's supposed to do
setting.relationship_dynamic: Individual working through a document with Sigma, no one else present
setting.background: Owen had a routine check-up and the after-visit summary uses abbreviations and terms he's never seen
setting.conversation_style: Short, relaxed sentences, reading terms aloud phonetically

scenario_template.topic: Owen addresses Sigma directly in his first line, describing the document and his confusion — e.g. 'Sigma, my after-visit summary is full of jargon I don't get. Can you explain what these recommendations actually mean?' One short turn, straight to Sigma.
scenario_template.note: The document and the ask arrive together.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks Owen to read the specific terms and instructions listed, so it has the actual content to translate rather than guessing at a generic visit summary.
scenario_template.note: Owen reads the specific terms, maybe mispronouncing one, which is realistic.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma translates the specific terms into plain language and explains what sequence of actions the instructions describe, based on the exact text read aloud.
scenario_template.note: This should reference his specific terms, not generic medical jargon explanation.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma distinguishes which parts are routine follow-up language versus anything that would indicate he should contact the office sooner, based on the actual wording, without diagnosing anything himself.
scenario_template.note: Sigma interprets language, it doesn't add medical judgment beyond what the text states.

scenario_template.topic: Owen reacts, relieved to understand it's routine follow-up, planning to just follow the instructions as written. Keep this realistic.
